title: Tetsuwan Atom Tokubetsu Hen: Kagayakeru Hoshi - Anata wa Aoku, Utsukushii...
justification: Checked by title. The film is TMDB movie 1293125 (Astro Boy: The Glorious Earth (2004)). TMDB show 12050 does not carry it, so the node leaves that show. The node moves from TVDB 79252 to the movie marker. This 20-minute short of 2004-02-07, 鉄腕アトム 特別編 輝ける地球 ~あなたは青く、美しい…~, is not TVDB S0E1 Remaking of Astro Boy (a making-of), and TheTVDB has no series episode or movie for it under its Japanese or English titles. TMDB has it as movie 1293125 Astro Boy: The Glorious Earth (Japan 2004-02-07, 20 minutes). AniDB types it a film, so the node takes the movie marker.
